title: The Magnificent view from the pass
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：magnificent　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 magnificent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the keeper wrote of ① a magnificent view from the pass in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② more magnificent than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the magnificent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most magnificent view from the pass anybody in the tower had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1945 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too magnificent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the magnificent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a magnificent palace by the river, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as magnificent as the palace by the river they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was magnificent or not, and he said so.

By 1958 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something magnificent, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite magnificent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the magnificent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1961, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another magnificent view from the pass in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more magnificent than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most magnificent palace by the river in the whole tower, she said in 1963, was the one she could never quite name; the magnificent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 壮丽（前置定语 a magnificent view from the pass：1951 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件壮丽的景色）
B. adj. 壮丽／极好（比较级 more magnificent than：文中两处，一处比山口看到的壮丽景色，一处比预想）
C. adj. 壮丽／极好（最高级 the most magnificent：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 壮丽（表语 too magnificent to do：母亲觉得它太壮丽，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 极好（前置定语 a magnificent palace by the river：叔叔把整件事称作一桩极好的宫殿）
F. adj. 极好（同级比较 as magnificent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩河边宏伟的宫殿相比）
G. adj. 极好（后置定语 something magnificent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 极好（受程度副词修饰 quite magnificent：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: a magnificent view from the pass
the most magnificent view from the pass anybody
a magnificent palace by the river
The most magnificent palace by the river in

answers.why: magnificent 意为“壮丽”，1951 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件壮丽的景色”，此处作前置定语 a magnificent view from the pass。
magnificent 意为“壮丽”，此处用比较级 more magnificent than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
magnificent 意为“壮丽”，年历上 一月 那行字说它是钟楼里最壮丽的一件，故用最高级 the most magnificent view from the pass。
magnificent 意为“壮丽”，母亲认为这件东西“太壮丽了，谁也用不上”，too magnificent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
magnificent 意为“极好”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩极好的宫殿”，此处作前置定语 a magnificent palace by the river。
magnificent 意为“极好”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩河边宏伟的宫殿一样极好”，同级比较用 as magnificent as。
magnificent 意为“极好”，年历上那半行字要的是“极好的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something magnificent。
magnificent 意为“极好”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当极好”，quite 修饰原级 magnificent。
magnificent 意为“极好”，1961 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要极好”，故用比较级 more magnificent than。
magnificent 意为“极好”，母亲 1963 年说的是“整个钟楼里最极好的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most magnificent palace by the river。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1951 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件壮丽的景色。（a magnificent view from the pass）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更壮丽。（more magnificent than …）
母亲觉得它太壮丽，谁也用不上。（too magnificent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩极好的宫殿。（a magnificent palace by the river）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩河边宏伟的宫殿一样极好。（as magnificent as …）
到了 1958 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件极好的东西。（something magnificent）
answers: In 1951 the keeper wrote of a magnificent view from the pass in the calendar.
Everybody said it was more magnificent than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too magnificent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a magnificent palace by the river.
He said nobody would call it as magnificent as the palace by the river they had once had.
By 1958 the calendar asked for nothing but something magnificent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 magnificent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the keeper wrote of a magnificent view from the pass in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most magnificent view from the pass in the tower, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too magnificent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a magnificent palace by the river, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite magnificent, and everybody laughed.
The magnificent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
